hero.title: Montespertoli wine, one flask at a time.
hero.lead: A small wine shop in the old town where you taste before you take it home. Local wine on tap, hand-picked bottles, a glass with friends. And everything that's happening in town, all in one place.

bottega.title: Taste first. Then decide.
bottega.lead: Nobody buys wine blind here. We pour it, we talk about it, and only then do you take it home.
bottega.c1_body: Wine from Montespertoli's producers, straight from the tap. Taste it, pick one, and we fill whatever you bring from home: flask, bottle, demijohn. You pay for the wine, not the glass.
bottega.c2_body: Chianti Montespertoli, riservas, a few Tuscan and Italian labels chosen one by one. For tonight's dinner or a gift that says where it comes from.
bottega.c3_body: A few tables, a chat, the right wine in the glass. In summer the tables move out onto Via Garibaldi.
bottega.c4_body: The territory's new olive oil, something for the table, and gift ideas for anyone passing through Montespertoli.

territory.title: The land of Chianti Montespertoli
territory.body: Montespertoli is one of the most vine-covered towns in Tuscany and since 1997 it has had its own sub-zone, Chianti Montespertoli: ripe Sangiovese from the hills between Florence and Val d'Elsa. The shop pours the wines of home, from Tenuta Ripalta, where Il Fiaschetto was born, to the town's wineries.

story.title: From the cart to the flask
story.lead: Il Fiaschetto's name is as old as the wine around here.
story.t1_body: Gino Conti carries Montespertoli wine to Florence on a horse-drawn cart, tavern by tavern. The humblest way to sell wine: you taste, you trust, you buy.
story.t2_body: The Conti winery is founded: the wine trade grows more structured, but the way of selling stays the same, looking the drinker in the eye.
story.t3_body: Roberto Conti opens the family's direct-sales shop on Via Garibaldi. Wine on tap, a taste, fill your own flask: that's where the name comes from.
story.t4_body: The Conti family passes the baton. The shop stays, and with Lara Bartalucci it becomes something more: a place where you drink, you chat, and you always know what's going on in town.
story.t5_body: Wine from the town's producers, a few tables, and the calendar of everything happening in Montespertoli. Il Fiaschetto di Lara is both.
story.why_body: The fiasco is Tuscany's hand-wrapped straw bottle, the one that sat on every table. The name says it all: here you take wine home the way it was always done, in your own container.

lara.title: The place where you know what's on
lara.body: Lara chairs the Montespertoli Merchants and Artisans Association. The summer street dinners every Wednesday, the Spring Festival, Halloween in the square, Christmas with the tree and the markets: she is behind them, together with the town's shopkeepers. And the association sits on the committee that organises the Wine Festival. Stopping by Il Fiaschetto means knowing before everyone else what there is to do.
lara.quote: Summer has only just begun, and we will always be here!

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This site is the shop window of Il Fiaschetto di Lara. We only collect the data you send us through the contact form, and we use it only to reply to you.
privacy.s1_body: Il Fiaschetto di Lara, Via Garibaldi 4-6, 50025 Montespertoli (FI), Italy. For any request you can message us on WhatsApp or call the number at the bottom of the page.
privacy.s2_body: Your name, a way to reach you (phone or email), the reason for your request and the text of your message. You type it into the form: we collect nothing else.
privacy.s3_body: To answer your request (art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). No advertising, no newsletter, no sharing with third parties.
privacy.s4_title: Where it goes and for how long
privacy.s4_body: The form is handled by Netlify, which hosts the site, with the safeguards the GDPR requires for transfers outside the European Union. We keep requests for 12 months, then delete them.
privacy.s5_body: None. The site uses no cookies, has no analytics and loads nothing from third parties: fonts and images live here. That's why there is no banner to close.
privacy.s6_body: You can ask us at any time to see, correct or delete your data by messaging us on WhatsApp. If you think something is wrong, you can contact the Italian Data Protection Authority (garanteprivacy.it).
privacy.s7_body: Links to Instagram, Facebook, Google Maps and Google Calendar lead outside this site: their rules apply there.
